Name: Thunder and Frogs Sounds
Author: Chread
Description:
[size=3][color=#ffd966]No more Custom Music! This content pack is a remake of [/color][color=#ffd966][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7450]Thunder and Frog Sounds for Custom Music[/url]. This version only requires [/color][color=#ffd966][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] and Stardew Valley 1.6 or higher﻿. 

[/color][/size]
Hello everyone!

This content pack aims to make the feel of rainy days more realistic. Currently the game has some weird sounds which are suppose to be frogs, but they really don't resemble a frog sound. So I thought to give it a change. Other than that, I thought the thunder sounds could use some work too.

In my experience this mod gives the game a much more "cozy" feel on rainy days. If you're not content with how the frogs sound, give the alternative version a go! It is listed at the optional files tab. It does not require the main file to work. Please only install either the main or the alternative version. Thanks to [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/4KMong?gameId=1303]4KMong[/url] for providing the files for the alternative version.

To see an example of what this content pack sounds like press the "[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20489?tab=videos]Videos[/url]" tab.



[b]Installation:[/b] Unzip the folder first, then you put the "[CP] Thunder and Frog Sounds" folder in your Mods folder. This mod requires you to have [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] installed. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3043?tab=files&BH=2]Custom Music[/url] is [u]not[/u] required.
[b]Compatibility:[/b]  The custom music version of this content pack is incompatible.



[i]Future plans:[/i] Compress sound files
﻿ ﻿﻿ ﻿ ﻿Add in wind sounds (maybe)
﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿Add in more triggers for the sounds (e.g. seeing a frog) (maybe)

If you have any suggestions let me know.

Check out my other content packs [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/chrisdegod/mods]here[/url].
